data.name: NoLid
data.value: This computer has no lid. These settings apply if it is used on one that does.

data.name: HelpText
data.value: When the Lid Is Closed sets what closing the lid does: on battery, plugged in, and with another monitor or a dock connected. Lock the screen locks and turns the screen off but stays awake; if the computer cannot hibernate, it is locked instead. With another monitor, the laptop's own screen turns off and its windows move to the other monitors, whatever is chosen. Lock the screen before sleeping locks the session before every suspend, so it never wakes unlocked. Changes apply at once; Reset restores the settings from when this window opened. When Idle sets how long the computer waits without input before dimming, turning the screen off and sleeping -- one column plugged in, one on battery, used as the computer switches between them. A video playing holds all of them off.

data.name: HintOnBattery
data.value: What closing the lid does while running on battery

data.name: HintPluggedIn
data.value: What closing the lid does while plugged in

data.name: HintWithMonitor
data.value: What closing the lid does with another monitor or a dock; the laptop's screen turns off either way

data.name: HintLockBeforeSleep
data.value: Lock the session before every suspend, so it never wakes unlocked

data.name: HintReset
data.value: Restore the settings from when this window opened

data.name: FileInvalid
data.value: {0} is not valid; showing the last good values.

data.name: BatteryInherits
data.value: On battery follows plugged in until it is changed.

data.name: HintDim
data.value: How long without input before the screen fades dark; on a laptop the backlight dims too. Any input brings it back.

data.name: HintScreenOff
data.value: How long without input before the monitors switch off

data.name: HintLockWithIt
data.value: Lock the session when the monitors switch off for being idle

data.name: HintSleep
data.value: How long without input before the computer sleeps. A video playing holds all of these off.
